guide.tagline: Bahria Town's gated city in south-west Lahore, off Canal Road and the Ring Road
guide.plotSizes: 5, 8, 10 marla, 1 and 2 kanal residential; commercial plots
guide.overview:
Bahria Town Lahore is Bahria Town's gated city in the south-west of Lahore, off Canal Road and the Lahore Ring Road. It is one of the largest and most lived-in private societies of the city.

Sectors and blocks

The society is divided into lettered sectors — A to F — and each sector into named blocks such as Jinnah, Iqbal, Rafi, Johar, Nishtar, Talha, Ghaznavi and Tulip. Sector C, with the main commercial, is the busiest.

Landmarks

Bahria Town is known for its Grand Jamia Mosque, the Eiffel Tower replica, its golf course, Bahria International Hospital and the theme parks.

Buying in Bahria Town

Check a plot's sector, block, approval and dues with the Bahria Town office before you buy. Browse the houses and plots for sale and rent in each block below, and call or WhatsApp the dealer directly.
